summary: Greptile P1s in services/desk-gateway, rebased onto cb9e385: gates_run and secret_scan execute the gateway's own gate scripts against an exported ref passed as data (4140823507); gates_run runs G-1..G-7 and cannot report ok:true on a partial run (4140823511); railway_redeploy compares prior_deployment_id to the service's current deployment before the write (4140823531); Play staged rollout preserves the releases already on the track (4140823534). Also posts the intake reply before advancing the record, closing the remaining ordering gap in 4140823522, and kills a timed-out child by process group so the git processes a gate starts cannot outlive it (extends 4140823546).

claims.claim: desk_gates_run and desk_secret_scan execute only the gate scripts installed with the gateway: the poisoned-export test asserts the bytes of every script exec'd, read at exec time, equal the gateway's own copy, and that no script path lies inside the export
A poisoned ci/gates/check_ownership.py — and a poisoned ci/gates/yaml.py, which the old sys.path[0] would have imported — leave no marker, so neither ran
The negative control above shows the same test failing against the previous behaviour, so it is keyed on the vulnerability and not merely green
With no trusted ci/gates installed beside the gateway, both tools return not_configured rather than falling back to the ref's copy
gates_run always runs G-1 manifest, G-1 ownership, G-3, G-4 and G-7; without a usable receipt_path it returns ok:false and names G-2 and G-5/G-6 in skipped and verdict
desk_intake_ack posts the GitHub reply before advancing the record: on a 403 the intake keeps its prior state and the failure names it; the unconfigured-gateway carve-out INFRA landed is unchanged
desk_play_staged_rollout reads the track and puts its existing releases back into the PUT, dropping none of them, and refuses to write a track it could not read
desk_railway_redeploy refuses with stale_deployment and issues no mutation unless the target environment's current deployment id equals prior_deployment_id
A timed-out run_command leaves neither the child nor a child of its own alive, asserted on recorded pids rather than on a process-name match
ci/tests/test_gates.py is green at this base: the TestWorkflowShellInjection failures this change reported on the previous tip were fixed by INFRA in ae56145

unverified: No gateway was deployed or restarted; all evidence is from the unit suite in services/desk-gateway and the gate scripts run locally
No upstream was contacted: Play Console, App Store Connect, Railway and GitHub are stubbed in the tests, and the gateway holds no credentials here
DESK_GATE_USER privilege dropping is plumbed and fails closed by design, but is not exercised by a test — it needs a real unprivileged account and a root parent process

G-1 on PR #33 attributes the whole branch to bot-00-programming-lead from the branch prefix, so every seat's files on this stack read as foreign to it. Pre-existing property of the stack-landing branch
Greptile was not re-polled for tip_match after these commits
